title: Can AI Deliberate? Evaluating Deliberative Quality and Belief Revision in Multi-Agent LLMs

contributions.purpose: 构建评测多智能体LLM协商质量的实验框架
contributions.mechanism: 2×2析因(结构化/非结构化×高/低态度确定性),7个利益相关者persona用GPT-4o-mini(temp0.7,seed42,Autogen)多轮辩论AI艺术商用议题,用Deliberative Quality Index(DQI,5维×0-3=满分15)+stance-flow分析
contributions.evaluation: 方法框架落地,产出4条件转录并评分
contributions.domain: 多智能体LLM/协商民主计算
contributions.source_quote: We implemented a 2×2 factorial design (structured vs. unstructured × high vs. low certainty) in which role-conditioned LLM agents engaged in multi-round debates on the commercial use of AI-generated art.

contributions.purpose: 揭示结构与确定性对协商质量的作用
contributions.evaluation: 结构化+高确定性最佳(14/15),非结构化+低确定性最差(8/15),中间态11/15与12/15;结构促文明与连贯,确定性促论证深度与互动
contributions.source_quote: the structured high-certainty condition achieved the strongest performance (14/15)... the unstructured low-certainty condition scored the lowest (8/15)

contributions.purpose: 指出LLM协商的根本局限(负结果)
contributions.mechanism: 跨所有条件观察constructive politics维度与主持人角色
contributions.evaluation: 负结果:所有条件下建设性解决方案构建始终不足,LLM无法复现人类主持人的细腻引导,仅达程序合规而非实质协商
contributions.source_quote: Across all conditions, however, constructive solution-building remained limited, and LLMs failed to replicate the nuanced facilitative role of human moderators.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We adopted the Deliberative Quality Index (Steenbergen et al., 2003; Steiner et al., 2004) as a standardized measure of deliberative performance.

Yet neither study evaluates deliberative normativity... As LLMs evolve beyond single-turn outputs, the central question becomes not whether they can simulate dialogue, but whether they can deliberate in the normative sense.

notes: 结构最完整的一篇,含明确负结果(C3:constructive politics跨条件均不足,LLM无法替代人类主持人)。实验细节红旗(相对温和):轮数描述前后矛盾——3.1节称Autogen'conducted up to 40 rounds',3.2节及正文却说'five-round discussions';图引用混乱(Fig.2-3/Fig.3-4指代不一;Fig.4与Fig.5标题都写'Unstructured + High Certainty',疑图题复制粘贴出错)。统计力度弱:每条件仅1条转录,DQI分(14/15等)为单样本无重复无误差棒;未说明DQI由谁评分(疑AI自评,存在评估者=生成者的潜在偏差)。AI披露:假设[B],实验设计/分析/写作[D]。协议适配良好。
